featured_reviews.review_text:
It’s not just about coaching classes. It’s about people. Moments. The ones that quietly hold you when you’re falling apart.

When I joined IMS, I thought I was just signing up for lectures and practice papers. But what I found was something far more meaningful — mentors who became friends, and strangers who turned into brothers.

Kapil Sir.
I still remember his first lecture. He casually mentioned he graduated from IIT Bombay, and then asked us, “Why did you choose this path? What made you take up Business?” That one question wasn’t just academic, it struck a chord. His presence was magnetic, calm, and healing. Even a minute with him could ease the heaviest mental storms.

I’ve had days where I isolated myself, thinking that would help me study better. But the moment I opened my math book, I’d feel lost again. Not once did Kapil Sir make me feel like a failure. He didn’t just teach, he stayed. With every silly doubt, every anxious thought, and even during the small moments (over farsan snacks or a shared laugh) he was there. More than a mentor, he became the elder brother I never knew I needed.

This post isn’t because he asked me to write one. It’s because I owe him so much more than words

And then there’s Amar Sir.

The mentor who never kept a boundary. Who didn’t treat me like a student, but like a friend. Who reminded me without ever saying it out loud that I wasn’t walking this path alone.

You don’t come across people like this often. Teachers who don’t just clock in hours but invest heart and soul into a student’s dreams. Teachers who aren’t just building careers, but characters. Teachers who choose people over paychecks.

Amar Sir, you’re a man to be crowned. Thank you for standing by me when I didn’t even believe in myself. For celebrating my smallest wins and holding me up during my hardest days.

While IMS might officially provides six-eight MyPlan sessions, I must have had countless hours of guidance and warmth, and through conversations with Kapil Sir and Amar Sir. And those hours were more than sessions. They were lifelines.

To Nishtha Ma’am, Deepak Sir, Manav Sir, Debdeep Sir, Ashish Sir, Ankit Sir and Vinaya Ma’am, you’ve all been more than just names in a system. You’ve been the light that guided me through the darkest corners of this journey. Each of you made me stronger, braver, and better than I was yesterday.

A thank you to the people who held me up when I didn’t think I could go on.
Because sometimes, the right guidance doesn’t just change your score, it changes your story.

Overall, IMS provided a well-structured and holistic preparation experience- from counselling and classes to SimCATs, b-school applications, and GDPI preparation, which ensured that I never felt lost or confused, and focus entirely on execution.

featured_reviews.name: Anurag Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am currently enrolled at IMS for my CAT preparation, and the experience has been exceptional. The structured curriculum and the resources provided are great, but the real value lies in the mentorship.

A huge thank you to Ahmer Sir, my QA and DILR mentor. I was struggling to see progress in my Quant scores for a while, but after implementing the specific strategies and 'short-cut' techniques he taught, I saw a significant jump in my QA scores within just a week. His ability to simplify the most daunting DILR sets and turn them into logical puzzles is incredible. He doesn't just teach you how to solve a problem; he teaches you how to think, which is crucial for an exam like CAT.

I also want to express my gratitude to Souvik Sir for his guidance in VA. His sessions have completely changed my approach to Reading Comprehension. He brings a lot of clarity to the Verbal section, making it much easier to eliminate options and improve accuracy in what can often be a confusing subject.

Beyond the teaching, the environment at this center is very friendly and encouraging. It doesn't feel like a high-pressure coaching factory; the staff and mentors are approachable, and there is a genuine sense of support among the students. Whether it’s clearing doubts or just getting a bit of motivation, I’ve always felt welcome here.

Highly recommended for any CAT aspirant looking for personalized attention and a positive study atmosphere!

featured_reviews.name: Lakshya Dugar
featured_reviews.review_text:
IMS Andheri was absolutely incredible. The centre is well maintained and is very safe, and the IMS portal, SIMCATs, and other resources are top notch. The course curriculum and overall structure are very well designed and helped keep preparation structured through the year.

I want to give a shout out to two faculty members who were pivotal to my CAT preparation. Rohan Sir is an excellent mentor and played a massive role in my quant journey. I struggled a lot with quant initially, and he explains concepts in a very simple, intuitive way that makes them easy to remember and apply in exams. He was every student’s favourite mentor. He was always approachable, super friendly, and is an overall awesome person.

Souvik Sir taught us verbal like a science. He is extremely knowledgeable not just within VARC but far beyond it as well, and his MyPlan sessions were especially helpful at different stages of preparation. He was always available on text, which made a huge difference during moments of doubt and uncertainty that are inevitable during CAT prep. He is probably the best verbal faculty in the entire CAT prep scene, and while that may sound like an exaggeration, any student of his well assure you that it’s not.

I also want to thank Apoorva who is always helpful when it comes to administration related things. I can wholeheartedly recommend IMS Andheri to any student serious about CAT preparation.

The only real mentor I talked to and got advice from during my CAT prep journey was Souvik Gupta Sir, with whom I had MyPlan sessions too. Sir was really very helpful in clarifying every small doubt I had regarding subjects, preparation and the exam itself.

Thanks IMS, 10/10 would recommend!!!!!

featured_reviews.name: S Das
featured_reviews.review_text:
I joined IMS(Andheri West branch) this year in August, to prepare for the CAT-2025 exam. I scored 94.02 percentile overall in the CAT exam this year, and I wholeheartedly attribute this success to IMS. The faculty at IMS Andheri West is extremely experienced and learned.

Our batch had Mohammad Ahmer Khan Sir for both Quant and DILR, and the manner in which he simplifies and breaks down concepts for students before delving deeper into the topic, helped me a lot to get a grasp on what the topic aims to convey, especially since I have been weak in the Quants section. I ended up with a 97.98 percentile in DILR, a section which I had found the most difficult in my CAT prep journey, but which became my greatest strength when the results thus came out.

For VARC, we had Ma'am Vanita Sanjay and Ma'am Sonia Saxena, both of whom are excellent faculties in their field. They taught us verbal ability in a methodical manner, with proper explanation of the arrangement of sentences.

We had morning classes at 7 am and although it was daunting at the beginning, to attend classes so early in the morning, I gradually started to enjoy as our course progressed and the concepts were made easier for us to understand. The SIMCATs, time to time whatsapp group alerts for extra masterclasses and offline ADMAT classes, as well as the modules/books that were received via courier from IMS before the classes began, helped me to amp up my preparation. I gained a solid idea about the exam and its components, and prepared accordingly. the Faculties were always available on Whatsapp as well as calls to answer doubts related to the syllabus, specific topics etc.

I also thank the centre incharges Ma'am Aasha Mahanta and Ma'am Apoorva for guiding me smoothly throughout the process of admission to IMS, enlightening me about the IIM selection process and for always being available to address various doubts and queries that arose from time to time.

It was a memorable time at IMS, and I highly recommend anyone who aims to appear for MBA exams like CAT, SNAP, NMAT, XAT, CMAT etc. to join IMS. It would help greatly in your exam journey and will give you a direction to structure your preparation for the same.
